outputs.discrepancies: Caption states that co‑expression of HMGB1‑GFP reduces MitoTracker Deep Red accumulation in Atxn1(86Q)‑transfected cells, but the images show the opposite: the Atxn1(86Q) column has reduced MitoTracker signal while the Atxn1(86Q)+HMGB1‑GFP column shows stronger/ restored MitoTracker staining. The visual data therefore contradict the caption wording.
